Abhishek Sharma achieves T20I bowling record for Indian openers

Abhishek Sharma made a significant bowling record in the second T20I against Zimbabwe, taking the last wicket to secure India's victory. He became the first Indian opener to achieve such a bowling feat in T20 Internationals. Sharma's performance included taking 3 wickets. This event also saw discussions about potential changes to the Indian playing XI for the third T20I, with mentions of players like Ishan Kishan and others nearing milestones.
